item.title: Global Reach and Innovation in Hoist and Crane Solutions
item.description:
Global Reach and Innovation in Hoist and Crane Solutions
#

LET WE BEAR YOUR LOAD
#

Since 1972, Cheng Day International Group has established itself as a leading manufacturer in the hoist and crane industry. The company is organized into four main business departments: Crane & Hoist, Elevator, Parking System, and Heavy Duty. Our expertise spans marketing, product design, manufacturing, testing, installation, and after-sales service.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Industrial Lifting with Electric Chain Hoists
item.description:
Elevating Industrial Operations with Advanced Electric Chain Hoists
#

Cheng Day brings over five decades of expertise to the field of electric chain hoist manufacturing, consistently delivering reliable and innovative lifting solutions. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our patented components and ongoing development of new models to meet the evolving needs of various industries.

item.title: Industry Events and Global Presence
item.description:
Industry Events and Global Presence
#

As a leading manufacturer of electric wire rope hoists and overhead bridge cranes in Taiwan, Cheng Day has established a strong presence at both domestic and international exhibitions. With over 42 years of experience, our company is recognized for its expertise and commitment to quality. Participation in these events allows us to connect with industry professionals, showcase our latest innovations, and engage with clients worldwide.
